what_went_wrong: guardrail_decision_latency_ns recorded wall-clock nanoseconds and was serialized into REPLAY_RESULTS and METRICS, so two identical replays produced different bytes — violating the hard requirement of byte-identical double replay.
root_cause: Non-deterministic time source leaked into offline deterministic output path; empty_metrics/finalize_metrics did not force-null the field.
impact: Double-run hash mismatch on first comparison attempt.
fix: Set guardrail_decision_latency_ns to null in every offline serialized location (per-decision, per-arm, aggregate, empty_metrics, finalize_metrics). Metric definition updated: null offline; populated only in live timing runs. Removed time import from runner.
verification: Double-run REPLAY byte_equal=true; SHA256 3BC63BAFBCF183BD1A719B17854B5536BBB501A29A76F5F1B0E4C70D3E4E359E; 26/26 admission tests pass.
